import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Paths
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
TRAIN_FILE = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv")
TEST_FILE = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv")
SAMPLE_SUBMISSION = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission_null.csv")
SUBMISSION_FILE = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_FILE)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_FILE)

print(f"Training data shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test data shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(f"Label distribution in train: {train_df['Insult'].value_counts().to_dict()}")


# Preprocessing text
def clean_text(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    # Convert unicode escape sequences to actual strings
    text = text.replace("\\n", "\n").strip()
    return text


train_df["text"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)
test_df["text"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)

# Fill empty dates if needed (not used for model but keeping format)
train_df = train_df.drop(columns=["Date"], errors="ignore")
test_df = test_df.drop(columns=["Date"], errors="ignore")

# TF-IDF Vectorization
tfidf_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=5000, ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=2, stop_words="english"
)
X_train_full = tfidf_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df["text"])
y_train = train_df["Insult"].values

# Stratified train/validation split
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)
print(f"Train size: {len(y_train)}, Validation size: {len(y_val)}")

# Convert sparse matrices to CSR format (more memory efficient)
X_train_sparse = X_train.toarray()
X_val_sparse = X_val.toarray()

# Train LightGBM classifier
lgb_train = lgb.Dataset(X_train_sparse, label=y_train)
lgb_eval = lgb.Dataset(X_val_sparse, label=y_val, reference=lgb_train)

params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "verbose": -1,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "max_depth": -1,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
    "seed": 42,
}

model = lgb.train(
    params,
    lgb_train,
    num_boost_round=500,
    valid_sets=[lgb_eval],
    callbacks=[lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
)

# Calculate validation AUC-ROC (hold-out estimate)
val_predictions = model.predict(X_val_sparse)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_predictions)
print(f"Hold-out Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Generate predictions for test set
X_test = tfidf_vectorizer.transform(test_df["text"])
test_pred_probabilities = model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission file
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {"Comment": test_df["Comment"], "Insult": test_pred_probabilities}
)
submission_df = submission_df[["Insult"]]
submission_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_FILE, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {SUBMISSION_FILE}")

# Print evaluation metric (competition requirement)
print(val_auc)
